strings: m_c licks the scrape on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} pelt fastidiously. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} might not be able to feel it, but {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} been warned of the danger of infection by r_c.
Rough ground in the camp has torn m_c's pelt as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/move/moves} around.
